remarks: Located in the desirable Woods at HoliMont community, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath townhome at 118 HoliView offers the perfect four-season Ellicottville retreat. Unwind in the dramatic vaulted living room with soaring windows, a stunning stone woodburning fireplace, and sliding doors that open to a private deck with a beautiful view of the WestMont Ridge development area. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area and fully equipped kitchen with abundant cabinetry and breakfast bar seating—ideal for entertaining after a day on the slopes or trails. Two thoughtfully designed bunk rooms on the first floor provide plenty of sleeping space, while the lofted primary area adds flexibility and charm. With the pullout couch, this townhome comfortably sleeps 12 people. Step outside and enjoy the peaceful wooded surroundings while taking in slope views from the deck, a perfect spot for morning coffee or après-ski relaxation. The Woods is known for its quiet setting at HoliMont, minutes to Holiday Valley skiing and the Village of Ellicottville, making this property an outstanding option for a ski getaway, year-round residence, or investment opportunity in one of Western New York’s most sought-after resort communities.
